name: kr.co.touchad.sdk.ui.service.TouchAdService
description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) starts this foreground service for app-install offers or a deferred web link. It checks whether an advertised app was installed, reports the result for offer credit, and can open a supplied page after the user unlocks the phone.
disableEffect: Install-offer completion checks and related TouchAd credit reporting stop, and deferred pages will not open.
